SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_x0_mean_7d, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_x0_mean_30d, STDDEV_POP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_x0_std_30d, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_x0_sum_30d, CORR(v.x0, DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS hub_x0_age_corr_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub = t.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, STDDEV_POP(l.y) AS hub_y_std_all, AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_y_mean_available_7d, AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days' AND l.available_at < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_y_mean_available_prev30d, REGR_SLOPE(l.y, DATE_DIFF('second', e.timestamp, l.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE l.date < e.timestamp AND l.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS hub_y_trend_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.hub = t.hub AND l.available_at < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 day') AS hub_events_1d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '3 days') AS hub_events_3d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_events_7d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS hub_events_14d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_events_30d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS hub_events_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub = n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, MIN(DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_last_event_age, LIST_EXTRACT(LIST(DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0 ORDER BY v.date DESC) FILTER (WHERE v.id IS NOT NULL), 2) AS hub_second_event_age, LIST_EXTRACT(LIST(DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0 ORDER BY v.date DESC) FILTER (WHERE v.id IS NOT NULL), 3) AS hub_third_event_age, MAX(DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_oldest_event_age, DATE_DIFF('second', MIN(v.date), MAX(v.date))/86400.0/NULLIF(COUNT(v.id)-1,0) AS hub_mean_interevent_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub = n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, (a.c1+0.5)/(a.p6/6.0+0.5) AS hub_rate_1_vs_prior6, (a.c7+0.5)/(a.p7+0.5) AS hub_rate_7_vs_prior7, (a.c7/7.0+0.1)/(a.p23/23.0+0.1) AS hub_rate_7_vs_prior23, (a.c30/30.0+0.1)/(a.p60/60.0+0.1) AS hub_rate_30_vs_prior60, a.c7/7.0-a.p23/23.0 AS hub_daily_rate_change FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '1 day') AS c1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days' AND v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '1 day') AS p6, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS c7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '14 days' AND v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS p7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS p23, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS c30, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS p60 FROM event v WHERE v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.active7 AS hub_active_days_7d, a.active30 AS hub_active_days_30d, a.active90 AS hub_active_days_90d, a.peak AS hub_peak_daily_count_90d, COALESCE(a.squares,0)/90.0-POWER(COALESCE(a.total,0)/90.0,2) AS hub_daily_count_variance_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.age_day < 7) AS active7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.age_day < 30) AS active30, COUNT(*) AS active90, COALESCE(MAX(d.c),0) AS peak, SUM(d.c*d.c) AS squares, SUM(d.c) AS total FROM (SELECT FLOOR(DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS age_day, COUNT(*) AS c FROM event v WHERE v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY FLOOR(DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0)) d) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.actors7 AS hub_unique_actors_7d, a.actors30 AS hub_unique_actors_30d, a.actors90 AS hub_unique_actors_90d, a.largest30/NULLIF(a.total30,0)::DOUBLE AS hub_top_actor_share_30d, a.squares30/NULLIF(a.total30*a.total30,0)::DOUBLE AS hub_actor_concentration_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.c7>0) AS actors7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.c30>0) AS actors30, COUNT(*) AS actors90, MAX(d.c30) AS largest30, SUM(d.c30) AS total30, SUM(d.c30*d.c30) AS squares30 FROM (SELECT v.entity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS c7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS c30 FROM event v WHERE v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY v.entity) d) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_x0_mean_7d, AVG(v.x0) AS hub_x0_mean_30d, STDDEV_POP(v.x0) AS hub_x0_sd_30d, FIRST(v.x0 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) FILTER (WHERE v.id IS NOT NULL) AS hub_x0_latest_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_x0_daily_slope_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x1) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_x1_mean_7d, AVG(v.x1) AS hub_x1_mean_30d, STDDEV_POP(v.x1) AS hub_x1_sd_30d, FIRST(v.x1 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) FILTER (WHERE v.x1 IS NOT NULL) AS hub_x1_latest_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x1,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_x1_daily_slope_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x2) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_x2_mean_7d, AVG(v.x2) AS hub_x2_mean_30d, STDDEV_POP(v.x2) AS hub_x2_sd_30d, FIRST(v.x2 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) FILTER (WHERE v.x2 IS NOT NULL) AS hub_x2_latest_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x2,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_x2_daily_slope_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COALESCE(a.s1,0) AS hub_x0_1d, COALESCE(a.s7,0) AS hub_x0_7d, COALESCE(a.s30,0) AS hub_x0_30d, COALESCE(a.s90,0) AS hub_x0_90d, COALESCE(a.n7,0) AS hub_events_7d, COALESCE(a.n30,0) AS hub_events_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '1 day') AS s1, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS s7, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS s30, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS s90, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS n7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS n30 FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COALESCE(a.d3,0) AS hub_x0_decay_3d, COALESCE(a.d14,0) AS hub_x0_decay_14d, COALESCE(a.d60,0) AS hub_x0_decay_60d, a.last_age AS hub_last_event_age_days, a.history_age AS hub_history_age_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(v.x0*EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/3.0)) AS d3, SUM(v.x0*EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/14.0)) AS d14, SUM(v.x0*EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/60.0)) AS d60, DATE_DIFF('second',MAX(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS last_age, DATE_DIFF('second',MIN(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS history_age FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.mean_x0 AS hub_mean_x0_90d, a.sd_x0 AS hub_sd_x0_90d, a.median_x0 AS hub_median_x0_90d, a.q90_x0 AS hub_q90_x0_90d, a.abs_x0 AS hub_abs_x0_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.x0) AS mean_x0, STDDEV_POP(v.x0) AS sd_x0, MEDIAN(v.x0) AS median_x0, QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.9) AS q90_x0, SUM(ABS(v.x0)) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS abs_x0 FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COALESCE(a.s7,0)/7.0-COALESCE(a.p7,0)/7.0 AS hub_x0_daily_change_7d, COALESCE(a.s30,0)/30.0-COALESCE(a.p30,0)/30.0 AS hub_x0_daily_change_30d, (a.n7/7.0)-(a.pn7/7.0) AS hub_event_daily_change_7d, a.m7-a.pm7 AS hub_mean_x0_change_7d, COALESCE(a.same_weekday,0)/4.0 AS hub_same_weekday_x0_mean FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS s7, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '14 days' AND v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS p7, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS s30, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS p30, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS n7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '14 days' AND v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS pn7, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS m7, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '14 days' AND v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS pm7, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '28 days' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM v.date)=EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp)) AS same_weekday FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '60 days') a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.n AS hub_active_entities_30d, a.repeat_n AS hub_repeat_entities_30d, a.max_events AS hub_largest_entity_events_30d, a.top_share AS hub_top_entity_abs_share_30d, a.hhi AS hub_entity_abs_hhi_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.n>1) AS repeat_n, MAX(q.n) AS max_events, MAX(q.mass)/NULLIF(SUM(q.mass),0) AS top_share, SUM(q.mass*q.mass)/NULLIF(SUM(q.mass)*SUM(q.mass),0) AS hhi FROM (SELECT v.entity, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ABS(v.x0)) AS mass FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY v.entity) q) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COALESCE(a.home_sum,0) AS hub_resident_x0_30d, COALESCE(a.visit_sum,0) AS hub_visitor_x0_30d, a.visitors AS hub_visiting_entities_30d, a.origins AS hub_origin_hubs_30d, a.visitor_fraction AS hub_visitor_event_fraction_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE p.hub=t.hub) AS home_sum, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE p.hub<>t.hub) AS visit_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT v.entity) FILTER (WHERE p.hub<>t.hub) AS visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT p.hub) AS origins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.hub<>t.hub)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS visitor_fraction FROM event v LEFT JOIN entity p ON p.id=v.entity WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, h.x AS hub_static_x, a.residents AS hub_resident_count, a.mean_x AS hub_resident_mean_x, COALESCE(b.s30,0) AS residents_all_destination_x0_30d, COALESCE(b.out30,0) AS residents_outbound_x0_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN hub h ON h.id=t.hub LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS residents, AVG(p.x) AS mean_x FROM entity p WHERE p.hub=t.hub) a ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(v.x0) AS s30, SUM(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.hub<>t.hub) AS out30 FROM event v JOIN entity p ON p.id=v.entity WHERE p.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') b ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.mean30 AS hub_label_mean_available_30d, a.mean90 AS hub_label_mean_available_90d, a.sd90 AS hub_label_sd_available_90d, a.n90 AS hub_label_count_available_90d, a.age AS hub_last_label_availability_age_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS mean30, AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS mean90, STDDEV_POP(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS sd90, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS n90, DATE_DIFF('second',MAX(l.available_at),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS age FROM labels l WHERE l.hub=t.hub AND l.available_at<e.timestamp AND l.date<e.timestamp) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.mean7 AS hub_x1_mean_7d, a.mean30 AS hub_x1_mean_30d, a.sd30 AS hub_x1_sd_30d, a.corr30 AS hub_x1_x0_corr_30d, a.weighted30 AS hub_x1_abs_x0_weighted_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity t ON t.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.x1) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS mean7, AVG(v.x1) AS mean30, STDDEV_POP(v.x1) AS sd30, CORR(v.x1,v.x0) AS corr30, SUM(v.x1*ABS(v.x0))/NULLIF(SUM(ABS(v.x0)) FILTER (WHERE v.x1 IS NOT NULL),0) AS weighted30 FROM event v WHERE v.hub=t.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.id) AS hub_n, AVG(v.x0) AS hub_mean, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS hub_sd, COUNT(DISTINCT v.entity) AS hub_entities, DATE_DIFF('second', MIN(v.date), e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS hub_history_days, (SUM(v.x0)+10*COALESCE((SELECT AVG(g.x0) FROM event g WHERE g.date < e.timestamp),0))/(COUNT(v.x0)+10.0) AS hub_shrunk_mean FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '1 day') AS hub_mean1,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '14 days' AND v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_previous_week_mean,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date < e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_previous_month_mean,REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS hub_slope60,COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days')/7.0-COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days')/30.0 AS hub_rate_change FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,DATE_DIFF('second',MAX(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS hub_last_age,ARG_MAX(v.x0,v.date) AS hub_last_x0,SUM(v.x0*EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/7.0))/NULLIF(SUM(EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/7.0)),0) AS hub_decay7_mean,SUM(v.x0*EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/30.0))/NULLIF(SUM(EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/30.0)),0) AS hub_decay30_mean,SUM(EXP(-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0/7.0)) AS hub_decay7_mass FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.1) AS hub_q10_90,MEDIAN(v.x0) AS hub_median90,QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.9) AS hub_q90_90,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_sd7,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS hub_sd30 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(DISTINCT v.entity) AS hub_entities30,COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(v.date AS DATE)) AS hub_active_days30,AVG(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN b.hub=v.hub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS hub_home_actor_share30,AVG(b.x) AS hub_actor_attribute30,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE b.hub<>v.hub) AS hub_visitor_mean30 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN entity b ON b.id=v.entity GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(v.id) AS global_n30,AVG(v.x0) AS global_mean30,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS global_mean7,COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.hub=a.hub)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(v.id),0) AS hub_event_share30,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.hub=a.hub)-AVG(v.x0) AS hub_global_gap30 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,MAX(a.x) AS entity_attribute,MAX(h.x) AS hub_attribute,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM v.date)=EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp)) AS hub_same_weekday_mean,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE (EXTRACT(DOW FROM v.date) IN (0,6))=(EXTRACT(DOW FROM e.timestamp) IN (0,6))) AS hub_same_daytype_mean FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN hub h ON h.id=a.hub LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x1) AS hub_x1_mean30,AVG(v.x1) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS hub_x1_mean7,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x1) AS hub_x1_sd30,CORR(v.x0,v.x1) AS hub_x0_x1_corr30,ARG_MAX(v.x1,v.date) AS hub_last_x1 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity a ON a.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.hub=a.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp AND v.date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(l.y) AS entity_y_count, AVG(l.y) AS entity_y_mean, STDDEV_SAMP(l.y) AS entity_y_std, ARG_MAX(l.y, l.available_at) AS entity_y_last, MEDIAN(l.y) AS entity_y_median FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.entity_id = e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, REGR_SLOPE(l.y, -DATE_DIFF('second', l.available_at, e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS entity_y_trend, REGR_SLOPE(l.y, -DATE_DIFF('second', l.available_at, e.timestamp)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS entity_y_trend_90d, ARG_MAX(l.y, l.available_at) - AVG(l.y) AS entity_y_last_minus_mean, AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') - AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS entity_y_recent_change, STDDEV_SAMP(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.available_at >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS entity_y_std_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.entity_id = e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, DATE_DIFF('second', MAX(l.available_at), e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS entity_label_available_age, DATE_DIFF('second', ARG_MAX(l.date, l.available_at), e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS entity_last_label_date_age, AVG(DATE_DIFF('second', l.date, l.available_at)/86400.0) AS entity_label_mean_delay, DATE_DIFF('second', MIN(l.available_at), MAX(l.available_at))/86400.0 AS entity_label_history_span, COUNT(l.y) / (1.0 + DATE_DIFF('second', MIN(l.available_at), e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS entity_label_daily_rate FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.entity_id = e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, en.x AS entity_x, h.x AS home_hub_x, a.away_fraction AS event_away_fraction, a.post_label_count AS events_since_last_label, a.post_label_x0 AS event_x0_since_last_label FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity en ON en.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN hub h ON h.id = en.hub LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(l.available_at) AS last_available FROM labels l WHERE l.entity_id = e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp) s ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.hub = en.hub THEN 0.0 WHEN v.hub IS NOT NULL AND en.hub IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 END) AS away_fraction, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= s.last_available) AS post_label_count, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= s.last_available) AS post_label_x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity = e.entity_id AND v.date < e.timestamp) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, AVG(v.x2) AS event_x2_mean, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x2) AS event_x2_std, ARG_MAX(v.x2, v.date) AS event_x2_last, AVG(v.x2) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS event_x2_mean_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x2, -DATE_DIFF('second', v.date, e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS event_x2_trend FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity = e.entity_id AND v.date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id, e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, l.ys[1] AS latest_y, l.ys[1]-l.ys[2] AS latest_y_delta, ABS(l.ys[1]-l.ys[2]) AS latest_y_abs_delta, DATE_DIFF('second',l.ds[1],e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS latest_label_age_days, DATE_DIFF('second',l.avs[1],e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS latest_label_available_age_days, DATE_DIFF('second',l.ds[1],l.avs[1])/86400.0 AS latest_label_maturation_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT LIST(y ORDER BY date DESC,available_at DESC) AS ys, LIST(date ORDER BY date DESC,available_at DESC) AS ds, LIST(available_at ORDER BY date DESC,available_at DESC) AS avs FROM labels WHERE entity_id=e.entity_id AND available_at<e.timestamp) l ON TRUE

WITH history AS (SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,l.date,l.y,LAG(l.y) OVER (PARTITION BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp ORDER BY l.date,l.available_at) AS prev_y FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.entity_id=e.entity_id AND l.available_at<e.timestamp) SELECT entity_id,timestamp,COUNT(prev_y) AS comparable_label_count,AVG(CASE WHEN prev_y IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN y<>prev_y THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS label_change_rate,AVG(ABS(y-prev_y)) AS mean_label_step,DATE_DIFF('second',MAX(date) FILTER (WHERE y<>prev_y),timestamp)/86400.0 AS last_change_age_days,AVG(CASE WHEN prev_y IS NOT NULL AND date>=timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' THEN CASE WHEN y<>prev_y THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS label_change_rate_30d FROM history GROUP BY entity_id,timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(l.date) AS matured_label_count,AVG(l.y) AS historical_y_mean,STDDEV_POP(l.y) AS historical_y_std,AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS y_mean_30d,AVG(l.y) FILTER (WHERE l.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS y_mean_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.entity_id=e.entity_id AND l.available_at<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(DISTINCT v.hub) AS visited_hub_count,AVG(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN v.hub=n.hub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS home_event_fraction,AVG(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' THEN CASE WHEN v.hub=n.hub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS home_event_fraction_30d,AVG(h.x) AS visited_hub_x_mean,AVG(h.x) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS visited_hub_x_mean_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp LEFT JOIN hub h ON h.id=v.hub GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(v.id) AS events_since_latest_label,AVG(v.x0) AS x0_mean_since_label,STDDEV_POP(v.x0) AS x0_std_since_label,COUNT(DISTINCT v.hub) AS hubs_since_label,AVG(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN v.hub=l.hub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END END) AS latest_label_hub_event_fraction FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT date,hub FROM labels WHERE entity_id=e.entity_id AND available_at<e.timestamp ORDER BY date DESC,available_at DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date>l.date AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,FIRST(v.x1 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) AS x1_latest,AVG(v.x1) AS x1_mean_all,AVG(v.x1) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS x1_mean_7d,STDDEV_POP(v.x1) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS x1_std_30d,CORR(v.x1,v.x0) AS x1_x0_correlation FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,FIRST(v.x2 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) AS x2_latest,AVG(v.x2) AS x2_mean_all,AVG(v.x2) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS x2_mean_7d,STDDEV_POP(v.x2) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS x2_std_30d,CORR(v.x2,v.x0) AS x2_x0_correlation FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.id) AS event_count_all, COALESCE(SUM(v.x0),0) AS x0_sum_all, DATE_DIFF('second',MIN(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS history_age_days, AVG(v.x0) AS x0_mean_all, 365.0*SUM(v.x0)/GREATEST(DATE_DIFF('second',MIN(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0,30.0) AS x0_annualized_observed, SIGN(SUM(v.x0))*LN(1+ABS(SUM(v.x0))) AS signed_log_x0_total FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days'),0) AS sum_7d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days'),0) AS sum_30d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days'),0) AS sum_90d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '180 days'),0) AS sum_180d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days'),0) AS sum_365d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '730 days'),0) AS sum_730d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,DATE_DIFF('second',MAX(v.date),e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS last_event_age_days,ARG_MAX(v.x0,STRUCT_PACK(dt:=v.date,event_id:=v.id)) AS last_x0,COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(v.date AS DATE)) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days') AS active_days_365d,COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month',v.date)) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days') AS active_months_365d,DATE_DIFF('second',MIN(v.date),MAX(v.date))/86400.0 AS observed_span_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS x0_sd_365d,MAX(ABS(v.x0)) AS max_abs_x0_365d,QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.5) AS median_x0_365d,QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.9) AS p90_x0_365d,MAX(ABS(v.x0))/NULLIF(SUM(ABS(v.x0)),0) AS largest_abs_share_365d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(v.id) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days')/30.0-COUNT(v.id) FILTER(WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '120 days')/90.0 AS count_rate_change_30d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days'),0)/30.0-COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '120 days'),0)/90.0 AS volume_rate_change_30d,COUNT(v.id) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days')/90.0-COUNT(v.id) FILTER(WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days')/275.0 AS count_rate_change_90d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days'),0)/90.0-COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days'),0)/275.0 AS volume_rate_change_90d,AVG(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days')-AVG(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS event_size_change_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

WITH ordered AS (SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,v.id,v.date,v.x0,LAG(v.date) OVER(PARTITION BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date,v.id) AS previous_date FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp), aged AS (SELECT *,DATE_DIFF('second',previous_date,date)/86400.0 AS gap_days,DATE_DIFF('second',date,timestamp)/86400.0 AS age_days FROM ordered) SELECT entity_id,timestamp,AVG(gap_days) AS mean_gap_days,STDDEV_SAMP(gap_days) AS sd_gap_days,MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap_days,COALESCE(SUM(EXP(-age_days/90.0)),0) AS decayed_count_90d,COALESCE(SUM(x0*EXP(-age_days/90.0)),0) AS decayed_x0_90d FROM aged GROUP BY entity_id,timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(DISTINCT v.hub) AS distinct_event_hubs_365d,COUNT(v.id) FILTER(WHERE v.hub=en.hub)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(v.id),0) AS home_event_fraction_365d,SUM(ABS(v.x0)) FILTER(WHERE v.hub=en.hub)/NULLIF(SUM(ABS(v.x0)),0) AS home_abs_volume_fraction_365d,COALESCE(SUM(v.x0) FILTER(WHERE v.hub<>en.hub),0) AS away_x0_365d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity en ON en.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,AVG(v.x1) AS mean_x1_365d,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x1) AS sd_x1_365d,AVG(v.x1) FILTER(WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS mean_x1_90d,CORR(v.x0,v.x1) AS corr_x0_x1_365d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,s.q10 AS x0_q10,s.q25 AS x0_q25,s.mn AS x0_min,p.latest_percentile,(l.x0-s.q10)/NULLIF(s.sd,0) AS latest_distance_from_q10 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.1) AS q10,QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.25) AS q25,MIN(v.x0) AS mn,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS sd FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp) s ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.x0<l.x0 THEN 1.0 WHEN v.x0=l.x0 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END) AS latest_percentile FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp) p ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days')::DOUBLE AS count_7d,COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days')::DOUBLE AS count_30d,AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS mean_30d,MIN(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS min_30d,AVG(v.x0) AS mean_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,s.slope_all,s.slope_90d,s.trend_r2,r.recent5_mean-o.older_mean AS recent5_minus_older,r.recent5_std FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS slope_all,REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS slope_90d,REGR_R2(v.x0,-DATE_DIFF('second',v.date,e.timestamp)/86400.0) AS trend_r2 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp) s ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(z.x0) AS recent5_mean,STDDEV_SAMP(z.x0) AS recent5_std FROM (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 5) z) r ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(z.x0) AS older_mean FROM (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC OFFSET 5) z) o ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,g.q10 AS population_q10,g.mu AS population_mean,g.sd AS population_std,(l.x0-g.mu)/NULLIF(g.sd,0) AS latest_population_z,p.low_fraction AS entity_population_low_fraction FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.1) AS q10,AVG(v.x0) AS mu,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS sd FROM event v WHERE v.date<e.timestamp) g ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.x0<g.q10 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS low_fraction FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp) p ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,g.q10 AS home_hub_q10,g.mu AS home_hub_mean,g.n AS home_hub_event_count,p.low_fraction AS entity_home_threshold_low_fraction,(l.x0-g.q10)/NULLIF(g.sd,0) AS latest_home_tail_distance FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity en ON en.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.1) AS q10,AVG(v.x0) AS mu,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS sd,COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM event v WHERE v.hub=en.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp) g ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.x0<g.q10 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS low_fraction FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND g.q10 IS NOT NULL) p ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,g.q10 AS last_hub_q10,g.n AS last_hub_event_count,g.mu AS last_hub_mean,p.away_fraction,(l.x0-g.q10)/NULLIF(g.sd,0) AS latest_acting_hub_tail_distance FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity en ON en.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.hub,v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(v.x0,0.1) AS q10,COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n,AVG(v.x0) AS mu,STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS sd FROM event v WHERE v.hub=l.hub AND v.date<e.timestamp) g ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.hub<>en.hub THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS away_fraction FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND en.hub IS NOT NULL) p ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,h.n AS home_label_count,(COALESCE(h.sy,0)+10.0*g.mu)/(h.n+10.0) AS home_label_smoothed_mean,h.recent_mu AS home_label_mean_90d,g.mu AS population_label_mean,(COALESCE(s.sy,0)+5.0*g.mu)/(s.n+5.0)-g.mu AS entity_label_shrunken_excess FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity en ON en.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.y) AS mu FROM labels v WHERE v.available_at<e.timestamp) g ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(v.y)::DOUBLE AS n,SUM(v.y) AS sy,AVG(v.y) FILTER (WHERE v.available_at>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS recent_mu FROM labels v WHERE v.hub=en.hub AND v.available_at<e.timestamp) h ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(v.y)::DOUBLE AS n,SUM(v.y) AS sy FROM labels v WHERE v.entity_id=e.entity_id AND v.available_at<e.timestamp) s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp,l.x0 AS latest_x0,p.x0 AS previous_x0,t.x0 AS third_latest_x0,r.min3 AS last3_min,r.mean3 AS last3_mean FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) p ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2) t ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN(z.x0) AS min3,AVG(z.x0) AS mean3 FROM (SELECT v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 3) z) r ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, a.mean_30d AS hub_x0_mean_30d, a.std_30d AS hub_x0_std_30d, a.mean_7d AS hub_x0_mean_7d, a.mean_7d-a.mean_prev_23d AS hub_x0_recent_change, a.peer_mean_30d AS hub_other_actor_x0_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS mean_30d, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS std_30d, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS mean_7d, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS mean_prev_23d, AVG(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.entity <> e.entity_id) AS peer_mean_30d FROM event v WHERE v.hub = n.hub AND v.date < e.timestamp) a ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id, e.timestamp, p.peer_count AS resident_peer_label_count, p.peer_mean AS resident_peer_label_mean, g.mean_y AS global_label_mean, (COALESCE(p.peer_sum, 0) + 20.0*g.mean_y)/(p.peer_count+20.0) AS resident_smoothed_rate, (COALESCE(s.sum_y, 0) + 5.0*COALESCE(p.peer_mean, g.mean_y))/(s.n+5.0) AS entity_smoothed_rate FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id = e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(l.y) AS peer_count, SUM(l.y) AS peer_sum, AVG(l.y) AS peer_mean FROM labels l JOIN entity r ON r.id = l.entity_id WHERE r.hub = n.hub AND l.entity_id <> e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp) p ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(l.y) AS mean_y FROM labels l WHERE l.available_at < e.timestamp) g ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(l.y) AS n, SUM(l.y) AS sum_y FROM labels l WHERE l.entity_id = e.entity_id AND l.available_at < e.timestamp) s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) AS slope_all, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS slope_7d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS slope_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') AS slope_90d, REGR_R2(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS trend_r2_30d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS trend_count_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, s.s7-s.sprev AS slope_change_7d, s.s30-s.solder AS slope_change_30d, s.s7*s.sprev AS slope_agreement_7d, s.s30*s.solder AS slope_agreement_30d, s.s7-s.s30 AS short_long_slope_gap FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS s7, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS sprev, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS s30, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS solder FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp) s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, s.vals[1] AS last_x0, s.vals[1]-s.vals[2] AS last_step, s.vals[1]-2*s.vals[2]+s.vals[3] AS last_step_change, s.vals[1]-s.avg5 AS last_minus_mean5, s.slope5 AS slope_last5, s.std5 AS std_last5 FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT LIST(q.x0 ORDER BY q.date DESC,q.id DESC) AS vals, AVG(q.x0) AS avg5, STDDEV_SAMP(q.x0) AS std5, REGR_SLOPE(q.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,q.date)/86400.0) AS slope5 FROM (SELECT v.id,v.date,v.x0 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 5) q) s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, (s.last_x-s.avg30)/NULLIF(s.std30,0) AS last_z_30d, (s.last_x-s.lo30)/NULLIF(s.hi30-s.lo30,0) AS range_position_30d, s.hi30-s.lo30 AS range_30d, DATE_DIFF('second',s.peak_date,e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS peak_age_30d, DATE_DIFF('second',s.trough_date,e.timestamp)/86400.0 AS trough_age_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT FIRST(v.x0 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC) AS last_x, AVG(v.x0) AS avg30, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS std30, MIN(v.x0) AS lo30, MAX(v.x0) AS hi30, FIRST(v.date ORDER BY v.x0 DESC,v.date DESC,v.id DESC) AS peak_date, FIRST(v.date ORDER BY v.x0 ASC,v.date DESC,v.id DESC) AS trough_date FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, s.std7/NULLIF(s.std30,0) AS volatility_ratio_7_30, s.std30 AS volatility_30d, s.std90 AS volatility_90d, s.var30*(1-s.r230) AS residual_variance_30d, s.slope30*7/NULLIF(s.std30,0) AS standardized_weekly_trend FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days') AS std7, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS std30, STDDEV_SAMP(v.x0) AS std90, VAR_POP(v.x0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS var30, REGR_R2(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS r230, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') AS slope30 FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days') s ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '1 day') AS count_1d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days')/30.0 AS daily_rate_30d, COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days')/7.0-COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.date<e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days')/23.0 AS activity_change, COUNT(DISTINCT v.hub) AS visited_hubs_30d, AVG(CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN v.hub=n.hub THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END) AS away_fraction_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, s.peer_mean AS home_peer_mean_30d, s.peer_slope AS home_peer_slope_30d, s.peer_count AS home_peer_count_30d, t.own_mean-s.peer_mean AS own_peer_level_gap, t.own_slope-s.peer_slope AS own_peer_slope_gap FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN entity n ON n.id=e.entity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.x0) AS peer_mean, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) AS peer_slope, COUNT(v.id) AS peer_count FROM event v WHERE v.hub=n.hub AND v.entity<>e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') s ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(v.x0) AS own_mean, REGR_SLOPE(v.x0,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) AS own_slope FROM event v WHERE v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days') t ON TRUE

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, AVG(v.x1) AS x1_mean_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x1,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) AS x1_slope_30d, CORR(v.x0,v.x1) AS x0_x1_corr_30d, FIRST(v.x1 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC)-AVG(v.x1) AS x1_latest_deviation, COUNT(v.x1) AS x1_count_30d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp

SELECT e.entity_id,e.timestamp, AVG(v.x2) AS x2_mean_30d, REGR_SLOPE(v.x2,DATE_DIFF('second',e.timestamp,v.date)/86400.0) AS x2_slope_30d, CORR(v.x0,v.x2) AS x0_x2_corr_30d, FIRST(v.x2 ORDER BY v.date DESC,v.id DESC)-AVG(v.x2) AS x2_latest_deviation FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN event v ON v.entity=e.entity_id AND v.date<e.timestamp AND v.date>=e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.entity_id,e.timestamp
